title: Length bound for an encoded vote
statement: For every bit $b$ and bit string $a$, encode the pair whose first component is the total first projection of $a$ with an initial $1$ prepended and whose second component is the total second projection of $a$ with an initial $1$ prepended, if $b=1$; if $b=0$, prepend the initial $1$ only to the second component. In either case, the resulting encoded string has length at most $|a|+4$.
